android.desc: All your favorite local pizzerias in one easy App Slice is the easiest way to order pizza from local pizzerias near you. Get delivery or takeout, customize your perfect pizza, track your order in real time, and reorder your favorites fast - all in one app! Customize your pizza your way Build the perfect pizza, down to every detail. Choose toppings, go half-and-half, add extra cheese, and save your favorite custom orders for next time. Add drinks, sides, desserts and more Round out your order with wings, mozzarella sticks, salads, pasta, and other favorites offered by your local pizzeria. Delivery or pickup, your choice Order pizza for delivery or pickup. Slice shows you clear delivery time and order details, so you always know what to expect. Fast, secure checkout Pay safely with Google Pay or credit card. Checkout is quick, simple, and secure. Track your pizza from oven to door Use our live pizza tracker to follow your order every step of the way. Always know what is happening and when your food will arrive. Reorder in one tap Save your favorite past orders. Reordering your usual pizza only takes seconds! Earn points toward free pizza with Slice Rewards Slice is your pizza loyalty app. Earn 1 Pizza Point for every $15 spent, and get a free large cheese pizza at 8 points. Find trusted local pizzerias near you Looking to try something new? Search for nearby local pizzerias, browse menus, and find a new favorite in your neighborhood. A better way to order pizza Enjoy high-quality pizza while supporting the best local pizzerias in your community. Slice makes it easy to order and reorder custom pizza from your favorite independent pizzeria.
